source: recorded groq openai/gpt-oss-120b output (effort medium), live evaluation round 3, 2026-10-29

plan.summary: Pulse Analytics is a SaaS analytics platform for small teams, providing a web dashboard and companion mobile app that let workspace owners manage members, view analytics, handle subscription billing, and receive real‑time alerts. Users include workspace owners and their invited members (viewer or editor).

requirements.statement: Users can authenticate securely via email/password and OAuth providers
All persistent data is stored in a PostgreSQL database
The system supports subscription billing for workspaces
Workspace owners have an admin dashboard to manage members, roles, and billing
Users receive real‑time alerts via push notifications on the mobile app
Workspace owners can invite members and assign viewer or editor roles
Authenticated users can view analytics dashboards in the web UI
The codebase includes automated unit, integration, and end‑to‑end tests
The application meets basic security standards (input validation, data encryption at rest and in transit)

assumptions: We will use Stripe as the payment provider unless otherwise specified
Push notifications will be delivered via Firebase Cloud Messaging
The analytics data to be displayed is supplied via an external API not in scope of this release
Deployment will target a Linux‑based cloud VM or container platform (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure)

open_questions.question: Which payment provider should be used for subscription billing?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The choice influences backend integration, compliance, and cost

open_questions.question: What notification channels are required (push, email, SMS)?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Determines third‑party services and data flow for alerts

open_questions.question: Which authentication methods are required (email/password, Google OAuth, SSO, etc.)?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Impacts user experience, security architecture, and third‑party dependencies

open_questions.question: What are the primary sources/formats of analytics data that the dashboard will display?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Affects data ingestion, storage, and API design

open_questions.question: What are the expected limits for team size and workspace count per subscription tier?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Guides database sizing, rate limiting, and pricing tiers

open_questions.question: Which cloud provider or hosting environment will be used for production deployment?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Influences CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, and cost estimates

recommended_stack.rationale: Next.js provides a full‑stack React framework ideal for the web dashboard and server‑side rendering; Flutter enables a single codebase for iOS/Android alerts; FastAPI offers rapid development of a Python‑based REST API that integrates cleanly with PostgreSQL; PostgreSQL is a reliable relational store that works natively with FastAPI and supports complex queries needed for analytics and billing.

tasks.title: Requirements Gathering
tasks.description: Collaborate with stakeholders to produce a detailed functional specification covering authentication, billing, workspace management, notifications, and deployment constraints.
acceptance_criteria: Specification document approved by product owner
All open questions (Q1‑Q6) are answered or documented as out‑of‑scope

tasks.title: Reference Architecture Design
tasks.description: Create an architecture diagram, component breakdown, and technology justification based on the approved specification and recommended stack.
acceptance_criteria: Architecture diagram reviewed and signed off
Component responsibilities mapped to stack choices

tasks.title: Setup Development Infrastructure
tasks.description: Initialize monorepo, CI/CD pipeline, and code quality tooling to support automated testing and secure builds.
acceptance_criteria: Git repository with protected branches
CI pipeline runs lint, tests, and builds on every PR

tasks.title: Implement Backend API
tasks.description: Develop FastAPI services exposing endpoints for authentication, workspace management, billing, and notifications.
acceptance_criteria: All core endpoints documented with OpenAPI
Endpoints pass unit and integration tests

tasks.title: Design Database Schema
tasks.description: Create PostgreSQL schema for users, workspaces, roles, subscriptions, and alert records.
acceptance_criteria: ER diagram approved
Migrations generated and applied without errors

tasks.title: Build Web Frontend
tasks.description: Using Next.js, implement login, analytics dashboard, workspace admin UI, and billing pages.
acceptance_criteria: Responsive UI passes manual usability test
All UI actions trigger correct API calls

tasks.title: Develop Mobile App
tasks.description: Using Flutter, create login flow, push‑notification handling, and an alerts screen for real‑time notifications.
acceptance_criteria: App builds for iOS and Android
Push notifications received on device

tasks.title: Integrate Payment Provider
tasks.description: Connect the backend to the chosen payment gateway to handle subscription creation, upgrades, and cancellations.
acceptance_criteria: End‑to‑end subscription flow works in sandbox mode
Web UI reflects subscription status

tasks.title: Setup Notification Service
tasks.description: Configure Firebase Cloud Messaging (or chosen service) to send alert push notifications from the backend.
acceptance_criteria: Backend can send test push and device receives it
Notification payload conforms to spec

tasks.title: Write Automated Tests
tasks.description: Create comprehensive unit, integration, and end‑to‑end tests covering all must‑have functionality.
acceptance_criteria: Test suite achieves ≥80% coverage
All tests pass in CI pipeline

tasks.title: Security Review
tasks.description: Perform a security audit covering authentication, data encryption, and OWASP top‑10 risks.
acceptance_criteria: No critical findings; all high‑risk issues mitigated

tasks.title: Release Preparation
tasks.description: Create deployment scripts, configure production environment, and perform a final sanity check before launch.
acceptance_criteria: One‑click deployment to staging succeeds
Rollback procedure documented

required_approvals.description: Approval of the overall project plan
Sign‑off on the reference architecture before implementation begins
Final go‑no‑go decision prior to production deployment
